We need to propose a 3-step retrosynthesis route for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1.

We have guidance: steps forward: 1) carboxylic acid to amide (coupling). 2) Doebner modification (aldehyde + malonic acid -> α,β-unsaturated acid). 3) sulfonamide formation (amine + sulfonyl chloride). So retrosynthetic steps reverse: Starting from target, we break amide bond to get carboxylic acid and aniline (or amine). Then break α,β-unsaturated acid to aldehyde + malonic acid? Actually Doebner modification forward: aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid -> α,β-unsaturated acid (with decarboxylation). So reverse: unsaturated acid -> aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid (or maybe malonic acid derivative). Then sulfonamide formation forward: amine + sulfonyl chloride -> sulfonamide. Reverse: sulfonamide -> amine + sulfonyl chloride.

Thus we need three retrosynthetic steps: Step1: disconnection of amide (C=O-N) to give carboxylic acid (the α,β-unsaturated acid) and aniline (the aniline attached to amide). Step2: disconnection of α,β-unsaturated acid to give aromatic aldehyde (the phenyl ring with sulfonyl group) and malonic acid (or maybe malonic acid derivative). Step3: disconnection of sulfonamide to give sulfonyl chloride (aryl sulfonyl chloride) and aniline (the aniline attached to sulfonyl). Wait we already have an aniline from step1? Actually target has two aniline nitrogens: one attached to sulfonyl (sulfonamide) and one attached to amide (anilide). The amide nitrogen is attached to phenyl (c3ccccc3N) which is an aniline (anilide). So step1: break amide between carbonyl and that aniline nitrogen, giving carboxylic acid (the unsaturated acid attached to sulfonyl phenyl) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). Step2: break unsaturated acid to aldehyde (aryl aldehyde attached to sulfonyl phenyl) and malonic acid. Step3: break sulfonamide to give sulfonyl chloride (aryl sulfonyl chloride) and aniline (the other phenyl with methyl). Wait the sulfonamide nitrogen is attached to the first phenyl (with methyl). So step3: break sulfonamide to give sulfonyl chloride (aryl sulfonyl chloride) and aniline (the methyl phenyl). So final precursors: (a) aniline (c3ccccc3N) (for amide), (b) aldehyde (aryl with sulfonyl group) (for Doebner), (c) malonic acid, (d) sulfonyl chloride (aryl sulfonyl chloride) and (e) aniline (methyl phenyl). But we need only three reactions, each step yields multiple precursors.

We need to construct JSON route: root molecule target, child reaction step1 (template for amide formation reverse? Actually retrosynthesis step is breaking amide, so template corresponds to forward amide formation (carboxylic acid + amine -> amide). The template ID we need to find. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria for functional_groups_broken = ["C-N"]? Actually we need template that forms amide (break C-N). Let's search for templates that break amide (i.e., functional_groups_broken: "amide"?). Use tool.
